issue_types.description: The canonical points to a different page, so this page will not be indexed.
URLs use http:// instead of https://.
issue_types.recommended_fix: Serve the site over HTTPS and build canonical / sitemap / Open Graph URLs from the https domain.

issue_types.issue: Invalid attribute in HTML (JSX attribute leaked)
issue_types.description: A React-only attribute (className / htmlFor) appears in the HTML.
issue_types.recommended_fix: Fix the component that renders raw HTML (dangerouslySetInnerHTML / markdown).

issue_types.description: The URL is harder to read or share (uppercase, underscores, encoded characters, IDs, parameters or too long/deep).
issue_types.recommended_fix: Rename the route/slug (e.g. /blog/my-article), and 301-redirect the old URL to the new one.
